C1253.title: Shanghai Pudong Cross-Border Credit Card Fraud and Chargeback Case
C1253.summary: The Supreme People's Procuratorate said that, beginning in January 2025, Zhang, Wang, Tian, and others used foreign credit card information to conduct more than 250 fake cross-border transactions on POS terminals at a hotel in Shanghai, defrauding domestic banks of settlement funds. International card organizations later initiated chargebacks for reasons such as fraud and unauthorized transactions, causing bank losses of more than 2.3 million yuan. Prosecutors characterized the conduct as credit card fraud and self-money laundering.

references.title: Shanghai Pudong: Precisely Characterizing Self-Money Laundering to Block Cross-Border Transmission of Financial Risk
